urls.rationale: 25 ILCS 170 Lobbyist Registration Act — Illinois's core lobbying-disclosure statute body. Single act-level page within chapter25.

notes: Chapter 25 (LEGISLATURE) lists each ILCS act as a single per-act `chapter25/<page>.html` leaf. 25 ILCS 170 is the only lobbying-disclosure act in this chapter; the remaining 31 entries are general-assembly procedure/operations/notes acts that do not regulate lobbyist registration or reporting.
